Runtime third-party distribution records — 2026-10-25

python-runtime/inventory.json records the exact locked runtime versions and
SHA-256 of complete license files copied from installed wheels. It additionally
contains the license files from downloaded Ubuntu-compatible CPython 3.12 Linux
wheels, including native PDFium and other bundled third-party notices.

The new online runtime lock does not depend on PyMuPDF. Historical offline OCR
tools and earlier immutable releases are outside this runtime migration.
No historical license obligations are represented as retroactively removed.

Project-maintained nature-figure QA tools retain their Apache-2.0 LICENSE and
SOURCE-NOTICE alongside the scripts. Modified geometry and overlay adapters are
identified there. Do not replace these with the author's installed skill copy.

Production uses an operator-provided, licensed CJK font. This release does not
redistribute the local Windows font used for testing. The target operator must
verify the selected Noto CJK font package and retain its applicable notice.

License inventory and wheel resolution are technical distribution records,
not a legal opinion or proof of successful execution on the Linux host.
